name: Xybernetex Supervisor for OpenClaw
description: Agent supervisor with observation and opt-in local tool restrictions.

verifyBeforeFinish.description: Ask the listed agents for one verification pass before a run's final answer (before_agent_finalize). Only runs with at least minToolCalls tool calls are asked, at most once each. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess.

interventions.description: Follow-up turns after a run ends: "retry" when it died with unusable model output, "verify" (check your work) when it finished. observe logs the decision; act schedules the turn in the same session.

agentIds.description: Limit to these agents; omit for all.

verifyRate.description: Share of finished runs that get a verify turn.

proposalTelemetry.description: Record hashed pending calls locally using the alpha v2 schema. No remote inference or learned enforcement.

preset.description: Named rule set prepended to rules. recommended: hold unrequested destructive calls for approval. strict: block unrequested destructive calls and hold unrequested outward-facing ones (push, publish, send). Both waive calls the user's own turn requested.

approvalDescription.description: Operator-written action, target and risk shown to the reviewer; do not put secrets here.

agentId.description: Agent id, or "*" for every agent.

toolName.description: Tool name, or "*" for every tool the risk classifier can judge (requires riskAtLeast).

paramsMatch.description: Exact, case-sensitive matches on the specified string parameters. Omit to match every call to this tool for the selected agent.

riskAtLeast.description: Match only calls src/risk.js classifies at or above this tier (e.g. any destructive exec command, not just one exact command). Combines with paramsMatch (both must hold) when both are set. A tool risk.js doesn't know how to judge never matches, even in enforce mode - it is skipped, not treated as low risk.

unlessAuthorization.description: Skip this rule for calls src/authz.js labels as requested by the user's own turn (verb and target in one sentence). Only "requested" is allowed - never own_artifact. Unlabeled calls still match. Every skipped call is logged as tool_gate_waived. Omit to apply the rule regardless.

endpoint.description: Full URL of the Xybernetex policy endpoint, e.g. https://api.xybernetex.com/evaluate

apiKey.description: Bearer key for the endpoint. Prefer the XYBERNETEX_API_KEY environment variable, which takes precedence.

maxToolCallsPerRun.description: Tool-call budget per agent run that the policy reasons against (both its step and cost budget).

logPath.description: JSONL log of every snapshot and decision. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/xybernetex-supervisor.jsonl.
